summary: Query strings keep commas literal (immowebQuery) so Immoweb list filters such as epcScores=F,G are applied.
reason: Immoweb ignores a list parameter whose comma is percent-encoded: --epc F,G produced the unfiltered count (1 576) while the site's own epcScores=F,G gives 521. Single labels worked, so the loss was silent.
validated_outcome: find --epc F,G now returns the same total as the site (521 for 1030,1080,1040 houses+apartments); TestImmowebQueryKeepsCommas.
